hook.name: hook
hook.reason: The formal bow and immediate address of 'Your Grace' establishes a high-status protagonist and an obedient operative instantly, though it requires a beat to understand the context.

narrative_tension.name: narrative_tension
narrative_tension.reason: Tension builds steadily as the informant details the extent of the betrayal at the estate, culminating in Alexander's lethal vow to let them keep believing he is dead until he strikes.

cliffhanger.name: cliffhanger
cliffhanger.reason: The clip ends on a resolute vow of vengeance that sets up a massive impending retaliation against the usurpers, though it serves more as a thematic button than a cliffhanger question.
cliffhanger.open_question: How will Alexander execute his vengeance and take back Ashburg once he has the proof?

context_independence.name: context_independence
context_independence.reason: While the core premise of a presumed-dead lord returning to reclaim his usurped estate from a traitor is clear, specific names like Lord Sterling, Lady Catherine, and Rupert lack prior context.
context_independence.blind_summary: A scarred man named Alexander returns from an apparent disappearance and learns from an informant that a usurper named Lord Sterling has taken over his estate and imprisoned his mother. Alexander decides to maintain the illusion of his death a little longer while plotting a devastating revenge.

confusions.issue: Unexplained backstory regarding Alexander's disappearance, his father, and Lord Sterling's rise to power.
Unclear identity of 'Lady Catherine' and her specific relationship to Alexander.

curiosity_gap.name: curiosity_gap
curiosity_gap.reason: The clip successfully lays out the high-stakes injustice and the protagonist's secret advantage, leaving the audience eager to see his retribution.
revealed: Lord Sterling has usurped his estate and imprisoned his mother
Alexander plans to let them think he is dead while he gathers proof
withheld: What proof they are waiting for
How Alexander will reclaim his title and punish the traitors

emotional_impact.name: emotional_impact
emotional_impact.reason: Alexander's clenched fists, tightened jaw, and cold fury effectively communicate deep emotional pain over his mother's imprisonment and righteous anger toward the betrayal.

stakes.value: A presumed-dead lord must reclaim his usurped estate and free his imprisoned mother from a treacherous rival.

missing_context: The exact relationship of Lady Catherine and Rupert to the estate
